ja.title: イボネスチマブの用量と投与間隔の比較に公開集計データはどこまで使えるか
ja.summary: 公開された用量群の集計値から、イボネスチマブのPK・PD-1占有率・VEGF変化・レジメン別の奏効と毒性を再解析した。等しい用量強度の20 mg/kg Q2Wと30 mg/kg Q3Wで最高濃度は約1.34倍、最低濃度は0.58–0.78倍と予測できたが、占有率の飽和と少数例の用量反応のため、用量と間隔の最適化は公開データから決められなかった。
ja.seo_description: イボネスチマブ（AK112、PD-1×VEGF二重特異性抗体）の公開集計データで、線形PKモデルの校正、20 mg/kg Q2Wと30 mg/kg Q3Wの定常状態曝露、PD-1占有率の飽和、奏効率と毒性のBeta-二項解析、識別できない点を整理した。
ja.seo_title: イボネスチマブの用量と間隔を公開データで比較

en.title: How far can public aggregate data support a comparison of ivonescimab dose and dosing interval?
en.summary: Public group-level data on ivonescimab PK, PD-1 occupancy, VEGF change and regimen-level response and toxicity were reanalysed. For equal dose intensity, 20 mg/kg Q2W versus 30 mg/kg Q3W was predicted to differ by about 1.34-fold in peak and 0.58-0.78-fold in trough, but occupancy saturation and small-sample dose-response meant that dose and interval optimisation could not be decided from public data.
en.seo_description: Using public aggregate data for ivonescimab (AK112, a PD-1 x VEGF bispecific antibody): calibration of a linear PK model, steady-state exposure of 20 mg/kg Q2W versus 30 mg/kg Q3W, PD-1 occupancy saturation, Beta-Binomial analysis of response and toxicity, and what is not identifiable.
en.seo_title: Comparing ivonescimab dose and interval with public data
